annotations.title: Latest COT snapshot of every market

description: The latest Legacy COT report of every market, 100 markets per answer (use offset for the next page): net positions of large speculators and commercials, their week-on-week change, and open interest. Filter by category. Available at every level. Both CFTC variants (Futures Only and Futures & Options Combined) with COT Premium and Data API keys; without an account and with a free account, each report's default variant.

category.description: A category or subcategory, e.g. "Energy", "Stock Indices".

variant.description: CFTC variant: futonly = Futures Only, combined = Futures & Options Combined. Default: the report's own (Legacy: futonly; Disaggregated, TFF: combined; Supplemental is published combined only).
